name: FA_MC_DEPRN_SUMMARY_H
description: FA_MC_DEPRN_SUMMARY_H contains the depreciation information originally stored in FA_MC_DEPRN_SUMMARY for audit and inquiry purposes for records that were accounted for. Only those records that were accounted for in FINAL mode in Subledger Accounting are archived into this table.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the asset number.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique book identification name.

columns.name: DEPRN_RUN_DATE
columns.description: The system date when depreciation was run.

columns.name: DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Asset depreciation expense amount.

columns.name: YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation expense.

columns.name: DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Total depreciation expense including the bonus depreciation recognized for the asset.

columns.name: DEPRN_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: The source from where the depreciation record was created. Possible values are BOOKS, DEPRN, and TRACK.

columns.name: ADJUSTED_COST
columns.description: Depreciable basis of the asset, calculated as recoverable cost for cost basis depreciation methods, and recoverable cost less the accumulated depreciation for net book value basis methods.

columns.name: BONUS_RATE
columns.description: Bonus rate used to calculate bonus depreciation.

columns.name: LTD_PRODUCTION
columns.description: Life-to-date production for assets that use a units of production method.

columns.name: PERIOD_COUNTER
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation period.

columns.name: PRODUCTION
columns.description: Current period production for a units of production asset.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORTIZATION
columns.description: Amount of revaluation reserve amortized during this period.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORTIZATION_BASIS
columns.description: Revaluation reserve used in calculating amortization of revaluation reserve. This changes only when the asset is revalued or an amortized adjustment is performed.

columns.name: REVAL_DEPRN_EXPENSE
columns.description: Portion of depreciation expense generated due to revaluation of the asset cost. Oracle Fusion Assets does not create any journal entries for this amount. It is for reporting only.

columns.name: REVAL_RESERVE
columns.description: Change in net book value due to revaluation of asset cost and sometimes also revaluation of depreciation reserve for revaluation period. For all other periods, the revaluation reserve amount after depreciation run.

columns.name: YTD_PRODUCTION
columns.description: Year-to-date production for a units of production asset.

columns.name: YTD_REVAL_DEPRN_EXPENSE
columns.description: Year-to-date depreciation expense due to revaluation. Oracle Fusion Assets does not create any journal entries for this amount. It is for reporting only.

columns.name: PRIOR_FY_EXPENSE
columns.description: Depreciation expense of prior fiscal years.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: Bonus depreciation expense. Amount included in DEPRN_AMOUNT.

columns.name: BONUS_YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: Bonus year-to-date depreciation expense. Amount included in YTD_DEPRN.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Total bonus depreciation taken since the beginning of the asset life. Amount included in DEPRN_RESERVE.

columns.name: PRIOR_FY_BONUS_EXPENSE
columns.description: Bonus depreciation expense from prior fiscal years.

columns.name: DEPRN_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator as to whether the depreciation amount for the period is overridden or not.

columns.name: SYSTEM_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: System calculated depreciation amount.

columns.name: SYSTEM_BONUS_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: System calculated depreciation amount.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction event which is associated with this row for accounting purposes.

columns.name: DEPRN_RUN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the depreciation submission.

columns.name: SET_OF_BOOKS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the accounting ledger.

columns.name: REVERSAL_EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction event which is associated with this depreciation reversal for accounting purposes.

columns.name: REVERSAL_DATE
columns.description: Date when the depreciation was reversed.

columns.name: DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Depreciation expense adjustment amount for the period.

columns.name: BONUS_DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Bonus depreciation adjustment amount.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: GENERAL_FUND
columns.description: Value of general fund after considering impairment effect.

columns.name: CAPITAL_ADJUSTMENT
columns.description: Value of capital adjustment after considering impairment transaction.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total impairment loss recognized for the asset.

columns.name: YTD_IMPAIRMENT
columns.description: Year-to-date impairment amount.

columns.name: IMPAIRMENT_RESERVE
columns.description: Impairment loss amount of the asset.

columns.name: IMPAIR_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated impairment expense.

columns.name: REVAL_LOSS_BALANCE
columns.description: Accumulated revaluation loss balance.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORT_BALANCE
columns.description: REVAL_AMORT_BALANCE

columns.name: ACCELERATED_ADJUSTED_COST
columns.description: The base amount on which the accelerated depreciation is calculated.

columns.name: BONUS_ADJUSTED_COST
columns.description: The base amount on which the bonus depreciation is calculated.

columns.name: ACCELERATED_DEPRN_AMOUNT
columns.description: The accelerated depreciation amount calculated for the period.

columns.name: ACCELERATED_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: The accelerated depreciation reserve balance for the period.

columns.name: ACCELERATED_YTD_DEPRN
columns.description: The accelerated depreciation YTD balance for the period.

columns.name: ACC_DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The adjustment amount calculated for retroactive adjustments included in the accelerated depreciation for the period.

columns.name: DEPRN_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR
columns.description: Controls the speed of depreciation of an asset by multiplying this factor by the annual depreciation rate.

columns.name: YTD_REVAL_AMORTIZATION
columns.description: Year-to-date revaluation reserve amortization amount.

columns.name: REVAL_AMORTIZATION_ADJUSTMENT
columns.description: Revaluation reserve amortization amount calculated for the period by the adjustment transaction.

columns.name: BACKLOG_DEPRN_RESERVE
columns.description: Life-to-date backlog depreciation amount.

columns.name: YTD_BACKLOG_DEPRN
columns.description: Year-to-date backlog depreciation amount.

columns.name: ANNUITY_INTEREST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: YTD_ANNUITY_INTEREST
columns.description: Year-to-date annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: LTD_ANNUITY_INTEREST
columns.description: Total annuity interest expense amount.

columns.name: ANNUITY_INTEREST_ADJ_AMOUNT
columns.description: Annuity interest expense adjustment amount.
